description: Use this when the user explicitly wants Nymrel Remote to read a UTF-8 text file with optional line pagination. Select the target with the optional device argument.

device.description: Paired device id or exact device name. Omit only when exactly one eligible device is available.

offset.description: 0-based start line; negative values read from the tail.

path.description: Absolute path or path relative to the configured working directory.

name: nymrel_remote_read_file
title: read file
